title: Fifth pillar of Iman – belief in the Last Day
intro: “Wal-yawmil-aakhir” – and I believe in the Last Day.

learn.text: So whoever does an atom's weight of good will see it, And whoever does an atom's weight of evil will see it.

learn.label: The fifth pillar of Iman
learn.en: And (I believe in) the Last Day.

learn.html: After believing in Allah, His angels, His books and His messengers, we believe in the Last Day. Belief in Allah and in the Last Day are the two pillars of Iman mentioned most often in the Qur’an – one right after the other.

Allah, the Most High, created two worlds: this world, called the dunya, and the world to come, the akhirah. This world passes away; the world to come lasts forever. In this world we live and work, and our life here ends with death. Death is not the end of life – only a change in the way we live. In the next world we will be brought back to life and live forever.

learn.text: Before the Day of Judgement come:

items: death and the time in the barzakh – the life in the grave,
Israfil’s first blow of the trumpet (sur) and the end of this world,
Israfil’s second blow of the trumpet and the bringing back to life,
the gathering at the place of the final judgement,
each person receiving their book, in which their good and bad deeds are written.

learn.html: On the Day of Judgement Allah (SWT) will judge people for their good and bad deeds. Each person will stand alone to give account before Allah. A person’s deeds will be put on the scales: whoever’s good deeds weigh more, Allah will reward, and by Allah’s mercy their place will be in Jannah. Whoever’s bad deeds weigh more will be punished, and their place will be in Jahannam – from which the believers, by Allah’s mercy, will later be brought out.

practice.title: What comes before the Day of Judgement?
practice.prompt: Tap the events in the right order.
items: Death and the life in the grave (barzakh)
Israfil’s first blow – the end of this world
Israfil’s second blow – coming back to life
The gathering for the final judgement
Each person receives their book of deeds

items.text: Deeds are weighed on the scales

questions.q: What is the fifth pillar of Iman?
options: Wal-yawmil-aakhir – belief in the Last Day
Wa rusulihi – belief in the messengers
Wa kutubihi – belief in the books
Wa malaa’ikatihi – belief in the angels

questions.q: Which two pillars of Iman does the Qur’an mention most often?
options: Belief in Allah and in the Last Day
Belief in the angels and the books
Belief in the books and the messengers
Belief in the messengers and the angels

questions.q: What is the life in the grave called?
Is death the end of life?
options: No – it is only a change in the way we live

questions.q: Whose place will be in Jannah?
options: Those whose good deeds weigh more, by Allah’s mercy
Those whose bad deeds weigh more

practice.title: Homework and talking
prompts: ✏️ The angels write down the good and bad deeds we do. Write a list of the good deeds you do every day.
👳 Talk with your mu‘allim: why is it good to cover other people’s faults in this world instead of telling everyone?
